{{Short description|Estonian politician (born 1958)}}
[[File:Maret Merisaar, 12. jaanuar 2008.JPG|thumb|Maret Merisaar in 2008.]]
'''Maret Merisaar''' (born February 13, 1958) is an [[Estonia]]n biologist and politician. She was originally a member of [[XI Riigikogu]].<ref name="riigikogu.ee">{{cite web |title=Juhatus ja liikmed |url=https://www.riigikogu.ee/tutvustus-ja-ajalugu/riigikogu-ajalugu/xi-riigikogu-koosseis/juhatus-ja-liikmed/ |website=Riigikogu |access-date=16 February 2021 |language=et}}</ref>

She is a member of [[Estonian Greens]].<ref name="riigikogu.ee" />
